title: Values schema for the llm-inferenceservice chart

role.description: The function of this model deployment (e.g., 'decode', 'prefill').

replicas.description: The number of pods to deploy for this model role.

model.description: Configuration specific to the LLM being deployed.

name.description: The common name of the model, used for naming resources.

uri.description: The location of the model weights, e.g., 'hf://org/model-name'.

tensorParallel.description: The number of GPUs required for the model.

size.description: The required storage size for the model's PVC.

extraArgs.description: A list of extra command-line arguments for the vLLM container.

extraEnv.description: A list of extra environment variables for the vLLM container.
